_comment: Example Open Socket configuration. Copy to .breakglass/sockets.json and edit.
This file is OPERATOR-OWNED. The agent can read it but never writes it, and can only invoke
the templates declared here — it cannot author a query. That is what makes the socket
retrieval-only by construction rather than by a keyword check it might get wrong.
Passwords are NEVER written here. `passwordEnv` names an environment variable.
Parameter discipline is the security boundary that matters. A `pattern` is the sharpest tool
available: '^[A-Z]-\\d{3}$' admits E-204 and literally nothing else, so the parameter cannot
carry a sentence, let alone a confidential document. Prefer a pattern or an enum over a bare
string wherever the value is an identifier.

templates.name: equipment_inspection_history
templates.description: Every recorded inspection for one equipment tag, newest first.
templates.statement: SELECT inspected_on, thickness_mm, inspector, findings FROM inspections WHERE equipment_tag = $1 ORDER BY inspected_on DESC LIMIT 50

params.name: tag
params.description: Equipment tag, e.g. E-204 or P-310A

templates.name: unit_alarms_in_window
templates.description: Alarms raised on a process unit between two dates.
templates.statement: SELECT raised_at, tag, severity, message FROM alarms WHERE unit = $1 AND raised_at BETWEEN $2 AND $3 ORDER BY raised_at DESC LIMIT 200

templates.name: latest_reading
templates.description: Most recent cached process reading for an instrument tag.
